name: airdour-win64-deps
description: MSVC headless/core deps for Airdour. Honest minimum for the next cmake/win64 slice past wasapi_io_smoke. GTK2 GUI intentionally omitted (dead end on MSVC). Stock vcpkg glibmm/libsigcpp are NOT Ardour-compatible — see features and overlays/README.md.

cxx-glib-modern-incompatible.description: Pulls current vcpkg glibmm (2.68+/2.90) + libsigcpp 3.x. Ardour/libpbd still requires glibmm-2.4 + sigc++-2.0 — do NOT enable for product link until an overlay supplies those ABIs.
